findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: There was a package of raw beef observed to be on top of a package of raw salmon. CORRECTED- The raw beef was moved to be away from the salmon. Ensure that food is protected from contamination during preparation, storage, holding, and display.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The sanitizer bucket in the kitchen tested to be at 0ppm of Quaternary ammonium. CORRECTED- The sanitizer bucket was remade and tested to be at 400ppm of Quaternary ammonium. Ensure that sanitizer buckets are being frequently tested and changed if not at the label-recommended concentration. It is typically recommended to change sanitizer buckets every two to four hours, depending on how often it is used. Ensure that staff are educated that sanitizer buckets should be made before food preparation or cooking begins.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: There were no Quaternary ammonium sanitizer test strips available in the facility. The facility uses Quaternary ammonium sanitizer tablets for their sanitizer buckets. A follow up is scheduled for 4/10/2026 to ensure that Quaternary ammonium test strips have been obtained. Ensure that there are always test strips available for every type of sanitizer used in the facility.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Allergen awareness training for CFPM
findings.comment:
The Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM) on duty is observed to not have their Allergen awareness training certificate. This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that there is always a CFPM on duty who has their Allergen awareness training certificate. 

410 ILCS 625/3.07(b). Allergen awareness training. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter. Training programs must be accredited by the American National Standards Institute or another reputable accreditation agency under the ASTM International E2659-09 (Standard Practice for Certificate Programs). There is no limit to how many times an employee may take the training.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: There were packages of raw shelled eggs on a container of cut onions and above a bowl of salad mix. CORRECTED- The PIC moved the eggs onto another shelf and proper storage order was discussed. Ensure that food is protected from contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: There is a drip leak coming from the pipes under the triple sink in the kitchen. The PIC has a plumber coming to repair the issue tomorrow. A follow up is scheduled on 12/12/2025 to ensure that the leak has been repaired. Ensure that plumbing is maintained in good repair to allow sewage to be properly disposed of.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: There was a phone observed to be on a food contact surface in the kitchen. CORRECTED- The employee removed the phone and the table was sanitized. Phones hold a significant amount of bacteria and should never be in contact with a food contact surface. Ensure that food contact surfaces are clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: The gasket of the clear door cooler in the kitchen is observed to be in a state of disrepair. This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that this gasket is repaired or replaced by next routine inspection. Equipment should be maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: There was no sanitizer observed to be made in the kitchen at the start of the inspection. The employees were preparing and cooking food. CORRECTED- A sanitizer bucket was made and tested to be at 400ppm of Quaternary ammonium. Ensure that sanitizer is made and available during all hours of operation and food preparation.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.
